name: m5-zd-clean-ab
description: Zinc's clean build mode ([retronym/zinc#100](https://github.com/retronym/zinc/pull/100)): `IncOptions.enabled = false` compiles every source with no analysis (no `xsbt-api`/`xsbt-dependency` phases, no stamping, no javac classfile analysis, no store write), against the default from-scratch compile that builds and writes the analysis.

One compile at a time (K = 1) of Pekko 1.7.1 `actor` (214 Scala, 30 Java sources) and `stream` (209 Scala, 3 Java), Scala 2.13.18, through Zinc's API (labs/zinc-direct). Zinc is sbt/zinc develop with the change (`dev-cb`, 51d1e13), loaded from `scripts/prepare-zinc-dev.sh`.
Timing: no profiler, 3 forks per variant and project.

variantDescriptions.default: `IncOptions.enabled = true`: the analysis is built and written with `FileAnalysisStore`
variantDescriptions.clean: `IncOptions.enabled = false`: the clean build mode, no analysis built or written
